transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I've called this meeting to discuss the borrower's request to renew its $10,000,000 revolving credit facility for another year. Before I make my decision, I'd like to hear from risk and relationship coverage. Let's start with the current collateral position — the schedule shows $12,000,000 in accounts receivable and $5,000,000 in inventory. At our standard advance rates of 75% on AR and 40% on inventory, the preliminary borrowing base would be $9,000,000 from AR plus $2,000,000 from inventory, totaling $11,000,000. That appears to support the requested $10,000,000 facility. However, I want to make sure we've reviewed eligibility and any other concerns before I finalize. What are we seeing on the risk side?
